migration.description: Bound content-mismatch recovery selection to an ordered partial index.
migration.release_unit_description: Phase-one artifact recovery follow-up; the index keeps recurring content-mismatch reconciliation bounded as artifact history grows.

compatibility_assessment.reason: The migration adds only an internal PostgreSQL lookup index. It does not change REST or MCP shapes, row values, or the fail-closed behavior of earlier candidates; the recovery-capable candidate uses the index when selecting existing content-mismatch rows.

durable_state.description: conversation_artifacts content-mismatch recovery work is selected by staging_reclaim_after, created_at and id through a partial index restricted to unavailable content-mismatch rows.
durable_state.storage_implementation: PostgreSQL partial B-tree index managed by embedded Goose migration 00016; no table, column, or historical data rewrite is performed.

source_compatibility_range.from_program_versions: Phase-one artifact content-recovery candidate containing migration 00015.
source_compatibility_range.to_program_version: Phase-one artifact content-recovery candidate containing migration 00016.
source_compatibility_range.compatibility_boundary: Earlier candidates ignore the additive index and continue to read the existing artifact rows fail-closed; the recovery-capable candidate benefits from bounded selection after 00016 commits.

ddl_structural_changes.description: Create a partial lookup index for due unavailable content-mismatch rows without rewriting historical artifact values.

progress_signals: Goose records migration 00016 after 00015 and the partial index is visible before the recurring recovery loop selects content-mismatch work.
Recovery selection remains ordered by due time and bounded by the existing limit while PostgreSQL can use the partial index.
pause_points: After 00016 commits, verify the partial index definition and query plan before enabling the recurring recovery loop on a large artifact history.

recovery.faulty_release_recovery: forward-repair-by-a-new-program-version; the index may remain in place while content-mismatch recovery admission is disabled

required_test_evidence: Migration from 00015 creates the partial index and repeated migration is idempotent.
Recovery selection returns due content-mismatch rows in bounded order without changing row values or states.
